description: Executors used to collect trajectories (paper App. A, 'Recorded generation and judging configurations'). Stock Harbor Terminus-2 2.0.0 in Harbor 0.17.0; the label is the model alias the agent is given. Spend valves are per-run safety limits enforced by the gateway, set above the cost of a full 100-turn run; they are booked with the gateway's price file and do not affect reported costs.

luna.description: GPT-5.6 Luna: Verified/Pro evaluation runs and most SWE-rebench training runs. Reasoning effort unset (upstream default); output-token caps and sampling parameters are not forwarded.

terra.description: GPT-5.6 Terra: part of the SWE-rebench training runs. Same settings as luna.

sonnet46t.description: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with extended thinking: Verified/Pro evaluation runs. Thinking budget 8,000 tokens; max_tokens 16,000 when the agent sends none.
